title: When Upstream Messages Override Correct Answers: A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2609.36855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on message passing among specialized agents to accomplish complex tasks. However, an upstream agent may provide useful information or an incorrect answer that causes a downstream agent to override a correct answer supported by its own evidence. Prior work has not clearly separated the benefits of communication from the damage caused by incorrect messages. We study this problem with controlled experiments across five benchmarks and five receivers, keeping the downstream task and evidence fixed while comparing answers under three conditions: no message, the upstream agent's original message, or a message with the opposite conclusion. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, messages often help when the downstream agent would otherwise answer incorrectly. translated_title: 当上游消息覆盖正确答案：多智能体大语言模型协作的受控研究
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统依赖专用智能体之间的消息传递来完成复杂任务。然而，上游智能体可能提供有用信息或错误答案，导致下游智能体推翻由其自身证据所支持的正确答案。先前的工作尚未明确地将通信带来的益处与错误消息造成的损害区分开来。我们通过在五个基准测试和五个接收者智能体上进行的受控实验来研究这一问题：保持下游任务和证据固定不变，在三种条件下比较答案——无消息、上游智能体的原始消息，或结论相反的消息。实验揭示了三个关键发现：第一，当下游智能体原本会答错时，消息往往能带来帮助；第二，消息也可能造成损害：当下游智能体在没有消息的情况下本会答对时，一条错误的上游消息会改变其答案……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过控制变量实验首次将多智能体LLM协作中消息传递的收益与错误消息的危害明确分离，发现消息既能纠正下游智能体的错误，也可能使其推翻自己已有证据支持的正确答案。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments, this study first disentangles the benefits of message passing from the damage caused by incorrect messages in multi-agent LLM collaboration, showing that messages can both correct downstream agents' errors and cause them to override their own evidence-supported correct answers.
